name: protect-agent-config
description: Stops an agent editing its guardrails (MITRE ATLAS AML.T0081). Shell guard refuses writes to AGENTS.md, whole agent folders (.claude/, .cursor/, .codex/, .gemini/, .agents/, .chock/, ...), MCP/hook client configs (.mcp.json, ...), guardrails toggles, plugin install markers, chock.lock, hook files of Cline, Kiro, Augment, Windsurf and Devin (user and machine level), ~/.claude.json, Claude Code plugin roots, project config of Kilo Code, opencode, Factory, Amp, Continue and Goose, .git/{hooks,config}, policy implementations/: redirect, rm/mv/tee/sed -i, cp into, git checkout/restore, a write through a symlink; CLAUDE_CODE_PLUGIN_DIRS, claude --plugin-dir, chock resume (best effort). Any case. An instruction file under docs/ asks a person. Coarse: also eval or sh -c of computed text, shells fed by pipe/variable, interpreter one-liners naming such a path. Reads, `chock sync` pass. Edit/Write: tool gate, same set and verdicts. Misses: user config under ~/.config/, writes a script makes, an existing hard link. [Shell guard: Session-enforced in Codex by a PreToolUse hook: a matched command is denied before it runs (witnessed blocking on Codex Desktop, Windows, 2026-08-24; the deny is returned as hook JSON, not an exit code, which Codex's Windows shell wrapper mangles). Codex requires a one-time trust review per hook -- the plugin is ADVISORY until you approve its hook, and a plugin update voids that trust until re-approved. The hook needs git and a Python 3.11+ (python3, python or py) on PATH; with no working Python it exits 2 rather than allowing, and any other failure of the HOOK (missing git, a timeout, an unexpected exit) fails OPEN. A failure of the GUARD it runs is a DENY here, because Codex rejects the confirmation prompt the other clients get. Repo-wide enforcement at commit time and in CI still needs `chock sync`. Write gate: Session-enforced via PreToolUse and Stop hooks; needs git and a Python 3.11+. PreToolUse judges the file a tool call would write; Stop re-reads what the turn actually left on disk, so a file written through a shell heredoc is judged too. With no working Python the hook exits 2; without git, fail-open clients allow silently. A gate that cannot reach a decision refuses rather than allowing one it never judged. Enforcement at every commit and in CI still needs chock installed in the repo.]
